ai.title: System prompt enforces file blocks for code and knowledge edits
ai.summary: System prompt in backend/src/system-prompt.ts mandates use of <file> blocks for all code writing and knowledge file edits. Adds explicit instructions to prevent raw code output outside file blocks. This ensures consistent parsing and editing behavior across the agent's internal logic.

eli5.text: Your coding helper now must write code only inside special labeled blocks, rather than pasting it freely in replies. You won't see random code floating around responses anymore; the helper's instructions were updated to keep things tidy and consistent. This is already live and affects how the assistant behaves behind the scenes.

ai.title: Tree-sitter fixes: Add Javascript & Python
ai.summary: Tree-sitter codemap parsing fixed for Javascript and Python. `common/src/codemap/languages.ts` splits TypeScript/TSX configs. `common/src/codemap/parse.ts` adds `IGNORE_TOKENS` and increases parser `bufferSize`. `common/src/codemap/tree-sitter-queries/` replaces complex doc-extraction queries with simplified identifier captures for JS and Python.

eli5.text: The codemap (an index that helps the assistant find and understand code across projects) now reliably reads through JavaScript and Python files instead of tripping up on them. The system stopped trying to glue comment blocks onto each definition and instead just records the names of functions, methods, and classes, which is more reliable for those languages. You don't have to do anything to turn it on; it takes effect automatically as soon as the assistant regenerates a project's codemap. If you've been getting partial or missing summaries for JavaScript or Python repos, those files should start showing up correctly going forward.
